claims.evidence: Brand and model are not legible in the photo; origin cannot be confirmed remotely.
The report does not show brake operation or condition; a video of braking is missing.
The report does not show gear shifting; a video of gear operation is missing.
This is a sales term not observable in the photo.
Age and purchase date are not shown in the photo; ownership history is not visible.

risks.risk: The bicycle may not be functional or rideable.
risks.proof: A short video of the bicycle being pedaled and braked, or ridden briefly.

risks.risk: Tires, brakes, chain, and gears may be worn or damaged beyond visible wear.
risks.proof: Close-up photos or video of tire tread, brake pads, chain, and gear cassette.
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing immediate repair or replacement

risks.risk: Parts may be missing or have been repaired or replaced.
risks.proof: Full set of photos from all angles showing the complete drivetrain, brakes, suspension, and frame.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete or with non-original parts

risks.risk: The brand and 'Belgium standard' claim may be false.
risks.proof: Clear close-up of frame branding, logos, and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unbranded or unknown generic bicycle

risks.risk: The bicycle may be older than the claimed 6 months.
risks.proof: Screenshot of a receipt or proof of purchase.
risks.if_unproven: priced as older or unknown age

risks.risk: Rust or corrosion may be present on the frame or components.
risks.proof: Close-up inspection of frame joints, bolts, chain, and spokes.

proof_requests: Video of the bicycle being pedaled, braked, and shifted through all gears.
Close-up photos of brand logos, frame number, and any branding.
Close-up photos of tires, brake pads, chain, and gears.
Receipt or proof of purchase to verify the age claim.
Additional photos from all angles to confirm no parts are missing.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a bicycle, so it can be priced at its worst case; all seller condition and age claims are unproven and require additional photos or video before any higher value is justified.
